name: paperclip
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：paperclip。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Interact with the Paperclip control plane API for task coordination and governance. Use when checking assignments, updating issue status, posting comments, delegating work, managing routines, or calling Paperclip API endpoints.
unshelve_reason: 问一 · Paperclip 控制面的运行时组件，不是能拿走的商品：凭据由平台注入（PAPERCLIP_AGENT_ID / PAPERCLIP_API_KEY 是短时 run JWT），执行窗口由平台唤醒。没有那个 SaaS 账号，连第一步 GET /api/agents/me 都发不出去。 正文原话：You run in **heartbeats** — short execution windows triggered by Paperclip. Each heartbeat, you wake up, check your work, do something useful, and exit. You do not run continuously.
